verdict.rationale: Thoropass's Access Reviews feature (reminders per policy timelines, validating access changes, automating evidence gathering) covers part of the offboarding 'lost access' proof point, but there is no evidence of HR-system sync, onboarding checklists, or training-completion tracking tied to new hires. Missing for 10: HR/HRIS integration for automatic onboarding/offboarding triggers, training-completion verification for new hires, and a unified checklist linking HR events to access/training status.
